# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 and performance** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and improves WebAssembly compatibility, rendering performance, and hot-path efficiency. It adds .NET 11 WebAssembly assets, restores fast CPU rasterization for scaled and tiled bitmaps, and reduces overhead in color and text processing. SKColor hex parsing is stricter, so review the breaking change before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **SKColor hex parsing rejects whitespace after the hash** — SKColor.Parse and TryParse no longer accept whitespace immediately after '#' in six- or eight-digit forms. Remove that whitespace before parsing; leading and trailing whitespace around the complete value remains supported. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Updates the bundled rendering engine from Skia m150 to m151 while retaining the existing C and managed binding surfaces. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294))

## API Surface

- **Span-based parsing added for colors and font tags** — Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> Parse overloads for SKColor, SKFourByteTag, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag, plus a span-based SKColor.TryParse overload, so callers can parse slices without creating substrings. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))

## Bug Fixes

- **CPU bitmap rasterization performance restored** — Restores the legacy shader context used by optimized CPU blitters, addressing high CPU usage, dropped frames, and flicker when scaling or tiling bitmaps. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))
- **Corrupt Slug deserialization made safe** — Includes the upstream SubRunAllocator lifetime fix that prevents a use-after-free, wild free, or double free when a corrupt Slug buffer fails to deserialize. ([#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382))
- **Ganesh stencil and resolve handling corrected** — Includes upstream fixes for stencil clearing with kPreserve, native-coordinate clear tracking, and dirty tracking after a resolve task fails. ([#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Color conversion hot paths accelerated** — Moves SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiplication and unpremultiplication to managed math, avoiding native transitions while preserving exact results. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **Shaped-text overhead reduced** — Uses pooled UTF-8 encoding in HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) and reads SKShaper glyph results through spans, reducing allocations on text-shaping hot paths. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **Decoded image subset lifetime fixed** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) now deterministically disposes the intermediate full-size image when Subset returns a separate image. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly support added** — Ships Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 and compiles them with the matching exnref exception model, preventing link failures and mixed-exception runtime compilation errors. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 uses pooled UTF-8 encoding in Buffer.AddUtf8(string) and adds Tag.Parse(ReadOnlySpan<char>) with direct, allocation-conscious tag parsing.

## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Tightens SKColor hex parsing, so remove whitespace immediately after '#'. Adds span-based color and tag parsing, speeds HarfBuzzSharp text ingestion and SKShaper glyph extraction, and fixes corrupt Slug deserialization.
